meta.title: Base64 Encode/Decode - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Free online Base64 encoder and decoder. Encode text, files, or image Data URIs in standard or URL-safe mode, and decode them back. Everything runs locally in your browser — nothing is uploaded, open, use, and go.
clickValidateMsg: Click Validate to check the CSV for issues.
steps_base64_1: Enter text or upload a file
steps_base64_1Desc: Type or paste text to encode, or paste a Base64 string to decode. You can also upload a file to encode its contents. All processing is local.
steps_base64_2Desc: Click Encode to convert text/file to Base64, or Decode to convert Base64 back to its original form. Toggle between modes as needed.
steps_base64_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the encoded/decoded output. Use in your code, API requests, data URIs, or anywhere Base64 encoding is required.
b64.desc: Encode text or files as Base64, or decode Base64 back to the original. Supports both standard and URL-safe modes.
